title: A stage-back of an item at refused does not take the run state, so a land started during its copy-in is not refused
goal: a stage-back of an item at refused (a land that stopped at checks) takes the run state with a staging progress event, so a land started meanwhile is refused, and gives it back when it ends

run:
import subprocess, tempfile, os, shutil, re, sys, json, glob, hashlib
R = os.getcwd(); T = os.path.realpath(tempfile.mkdtemp()); S = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), 'c.sqlite')
env = dict(os.environ, KB_COORD_STORE=S)
sys.path.insert(0, R + '/_tools')
import bl_dispatch
def sh(*a, cwd=None): return subprocess.run(a, cwd=cwd or T, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
g = lambda *a: sh('git', '-c', 'user.email=a@b', '-c', 'user.name=n', *a)
g('init', '-q', '-b', 'main', '.'); shutil.copy(R + '/backlog.json', T); os.makedirs(T + '/kb/_self/backlog')
bl = lambda *a: sh(sys.executable, R + '/_tools/backlog.py', '--root', T, *a)
def c(*a): return subprocess.run([sys.executable, R + '/_tools/coord.py', '--store', S, *a], capture_output=True, text=True)
sp = re.search(r'SP-\w+', bl('new', 'sprint', '--title', 'S', '--goal', 'g').stdout).group(0)
iid = re.search(r'ST-\w+', bl('new', 'story', '--title', 'Planted', '--goal', 'g', '--touch', '.claude/staged.txt',
                              '--check', 'python3 -c pass').stdout).group(0)
for f in glob.glob(T + '/kb/_self/backlog/*.json'):
    d = json.load(open(f, encoding='utf-8'))
    if d['id'] == sp: d['status'] = 'active'
    if d['id'] == iid: d['status'] = 'doing'; d['sprint'] = sp
    json.dump(d, open(f, 'w', encoding='utf-8'), indent=2)
os.makedirs(T + '/.claude'); open(T + '/.claude/staged.txt', 'w').write('base\n')
open(T + '/.gitignore', 'w').write('.claude/worktrees/\n_cache/\n')
g('add', '-A'); g('commit', '-q', '-m', 'planted')
wt, scratch = str(bl_dispatch.worktree_path(T, iid)), bl_dispatch.scratch_path(T, iid)
g('worktree', 'add', '-q', '-b', 'work/' + iid, wt)
copy = scratch / bl_dispatch.STAGING / '.claude' / 'staged.txt'
copy.parent.mkdir(parents=True); copy.write_text('edited\n')
(scratch / bl_dispatch.BASES_NAME).write_text(json.dumps({'.claude/staged.txt': hashlib.sha256(b'base\n').hexdigest()}))
for s in ('claimed', 'working', 'returned', 'landing', 'refused'): c('transition', 'run/' + iid, '--to', s)  # land stopped at checks
r = bl('stage-back', iid, '--check')
states = [e['fields'].get('state') for e in json.loads(c('wait', '--since', '0', '--timeout', '0', '--kind', 'progress', '--item', iid).stdout)['events']]
print('stage-back of a refused item', r.returncode, '| states', states)
sys.exit(0 if r.returncode == 0 and 'staging' in states[states.index('refused'):] else 1)
